## Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what happened.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to `/` or `/docs`
2. Select theme / wallpaper / component
3. Observe issue

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to see instead.

## Environment
- **Browser & Version**: (e.g., Chrome 131, Safari 18, Firefox 133)
- **OS & Refresh Rate**: (e.g., macOS 15 120Hz, Windows 11 144Hz, iOS 26)
- **Theme**: Dark / Light
- **Viewport**: Desktop / Tablet / Mobile

## Screenshots / Screen Recording
If applicable, attach screenshots to help illustrate the issue.
